verdict.rationale: Gmail's own Gemini integration can label and bulk-act on emails when the user asks it to, which is user-steered, AI-driven organization. The evidence does not show automatic, continuous AI triage; Gmail filters do auto-label, but they are rule-based rather than AI. Missing for 10: automatic AI labeling/categorization of incoming mail without prompting, AI surfacing of what needs attention, an audit trail or explanation of AI triage decisions, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI triages my inbox for me — auto-labeling, categorizing, and surfacing what needs attention — with behavior I can steer and audit

citations.quote: Organize: Ask Gemini to do things like delete multiple emails or add labels.
